articles.title: Samsung SWA President & CEO JB Park’s Message on Completing 30 Years in India & the Launch of #PoweringInnovationforIndia
articles.summary: An entity established in New Delhi in 1995 celebrates three decades of significant contribution to India's growth and innovation. Beginning with modest operations, it has consistently built and evolved, demonstrating a long-term commitment to national development and progress alongside the nation over the past thirty years.

articles.title: Record order books, rising exports: Nirmal Bang’s Jyoti Gupta on why defence remains a long-term growth story
articles.summary: India's defence manufacturing sector is experiencing a significant upcycle, driven by record approvals, a robust multi-year order book, and rising indigenisation. Accelerating exports further bolster India's self-reliance and global competitiveness in military production. This positive trend highlights substantial growth and enhanced capabilities within the nation's defence industry, crucial for national security and strategic autonomy.

articles.title: Trump Unable To Flip Coins; Overturns Accessibility Instead
articles.summary: The article critically evaluates former President Trump's financial management, portraying it as a leading example of poor decision-making. It suggests his economic policies and actions led to national economic backsliding. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the importance of effective financial leadership and its broad impact on national prosperity and governance.
